name: Caribou Habitat Restoration Fund
summary: Grants for on-the-ground functional and ecological restoration of roads, seismic lines and other disturbed features in priority caribou habitat in British Columbia, with seed grants available to develop proposals.
reporting: Approved multi-year projects are required to submit annual grant reports each Spring and Progress Updates each Fall.

access.quote: All applications must be submitted online using Survey Apply. HCTF cannot accept applications by email.
